title: AnnouncementsPreferencesSummary
description: The summary object for announcement email preferences.

BaseAnnouncementsPreferences.description: The object that contains the announcement email preferences configured for the tenancy (root compartment).

compartmentId.description:
The OCID of the compartment for which the email preferences apply. Because announcements are
specific to a tenancy, specify the tenancy by providing the root compartment OCID.

isUnsubscribed.description:
A Boolean value to indicate whether the specified compartment chooses to not to receive informational announcements by email.
(Manage preferences for receiving announcements by email by specifying the `preferenceType` attribute instead.)

preferenceType.description: The string representing the user's preference regarding receiving announcements by email.

preferredTimeZone.description: The time zone in which the user prefers to receive announcements. Specify the preference with a value that uses the IANA Time Zone Database format (x-obmcs-time-zone). For example - America/Los_Angeles

timeCreated.description: When the preferences were set initially.

timeUpdated.description: When the preferences were last updated.

type.description: The entity type, which specifies either an object or a summary object for announcement email preferences.
